meta.name: Track and classify Facebook ad angles with Apify, OpenAI, and Supabase

parameters.content:
## Track top-performing Facebook ads for Shopify products with Apify, OpenAI and Supbase

### How it works

This workflow manually runs a Facebook Ads Library ingestion pipeline, scrapes ads with Apify, normalizes the results, and enriches each ad with an OpenAI-derived angle classification. It stores ad records in Supabase, filters for newly inserted ads, and embeds their ad copy into a Supabase vector store. In parallel, ads with destination URLs are probed for Shopify product data, deduplicated, and stored as product rows in Supabase.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Apify credentials and actor/input settings for the Facebook Ads scraper.
- Add OpenAI credentials for both ad angle classification and embeddings generation.
- Configure Supabase credentials, target tables for ad and product rows, and the Supabase vector store/table used for embedded ad copy.
- Edit the dataset input values such as adLibraryUrl, adLibraryUrlUk, and maxAds to match the accounts or markets you want to collect.
- Ensure destination and Shopify probe URL logic in the code nodes matches the expected structure of the scraped ad data.

### Who's it for

Marketing teams and DTC copywriters who want to see which Facebook ads run longest, reach the widest EU audience, and what persuasion angles they use.

### Customization

Adjust the ad row and product row code nodes to change the stored schema, tune the OpenAI classification prompt/categories, or modify the deduplication criteria for products.

## Manual input setup

Starts the workflow manually and defines the initial Facebook Ads Library URLs and scrape limits used by the rest of the pipeline.

## Scrape and prepare ads

Runs the Apify Facebook Ads scraper and converts the scraped output into normalized ad items before branching into ad storage and product discovery paths.

## Probe destination stores

Filters ads that have a destination URL and sends a Shopify probe request to check whether product information can be extracted.

## Save product records

Builds structured product rows from the Shopify probe response, removes duplicate products, and inserts the resulting product records into Supabase.

## Classify ad angle

Uses OpenAI to categorize or label the advertising angle for each prepared ad item.

## Store new ads

Assembles the final ad record, inserts it into Supabase, and filters the result so only newly added ads continue to embedding.

## Embed ad copy

Creates vector embeddings for new ad copy using OpenAI, loads the document content, and stores the embedded records in a Supabase vector store.

values.content: You are labeling Facebook ads for a marketing intelligence dataset. You will be given the text of one ad. Classify the main persuasion angle it uses into exactly one category from this list: "urgency", "social proof", "founder story", "problem solution", "discount", "curiosity", "authority", "other". Judge only the ad text. Return a single JSON object with two keys: "angle" (one of the categories) and "reasoning" (a short phrase under 10 words). Return only the JSON object.
